description: Untrusted input crosses a trust boundary without validation.
detection_hint: Trace request, file, environment, and tool input into commands, SQL, HTML, paths, or deserialization.
fix_guidance: Validate at the boundary and use parameterized or escaped APIs.

description: Failures are swallowed or converted into misleading success.
detection_hint: Find empty catch blocks, broad ignore handlers, and fallback values on write or security paths.
fix_guidance: Preserve typed failure context and recover only where a correct fallback exists.

description: Resource lifetime is not scoped to acquisition.
detection_hint: Inspect files, sockets, processes, subscriptions, timers, and database handles for all exit paths.
fix_guidance: Use acquire/use/release or a scoped resource abstraction.

description: Shared mutable state can race under concurrent work.
detection_hint: Locate read-modify-write sequences and mutable maps used across requests, streams, or fibers.
fix_guidance: Serialize mutations, use atomic primitives, or move ownership behind a service.

description: A function or module combines unrelated responsibilities.
detection_hint: Look for modules with many reasons to change, unrelated imports, or orchestration mixed with persistence details.
fix_guidance: Extract cohesive services at stable architectural boundaries.

description: Repeated work scales with input size or render frequency.
detection_hint: Look for nested scans, repeated parsing, queries in loops, and recomputation in hot paths.
fix_guidance: Index, batch, cache with explicit invalidation, or move work outside the loop.

description: Dead or duplicate logic obscures the active behavior.
detection_hint: Find unused exports, unreachable branches, parallel implementations, and stale feature flags.
fix_guidance: Remove dead paths and centralize shared runtime logic.

description: Tests assert implementation details instead of behavior and failure semantics.
detection_hint: Review mocks and assertions for coupling to internal calls while edge cases and recovery paths are absent.
fix_guidance: Test observable contracts, boundaries, retries, and partial-failure behavior.
